svg.text: nn.Linear stores W as [out, in] and computes x @ Wᵀ; each output cell = one row of x · one column of Wᵀ
Multiply pairwise and add → ONE cell (green).
The inner 2048 must match on both sides
and it disappears from the result:
Output width = number of columns of Wᵀ:
k and v get 512 (8 heads × 64): GQA.
